newsitem.title: UKRAINE: New Ukraine group to promote small business - aide.
newsitem.headline: New Ukraine group to promote small business - aide.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma has appointed former economics minister Yuri Yekhanurov to head a new Committee to Promote Business Development, a presidential spokesman said on Wednesday.
The committee will work to increase the number of small and medium businesses in the former Soviet republic, Yevhen Kushnaryov, head of the presidential administration, told a news conference.
"This is the true beginning of support for small and medium business," Kushnaryov said, adding that only five percent of Ukrainians were running small and medium businesses.

"This (small business development) today is one of the main directions which will, to a great degree, play a part in furthering economic reforms, and in the economic state of our country," Kushnaryov said.
Yekhanurov, removed from his post as Economy Minister in Kuchma's recent cabinet shuffle, previously headed the state privatisation agency.
